title: Simultaneously optimal queries to both quantum linear-system oracles
source: Low and Su, Section~7, Eq.~(241), with the supplied-norm-estimate convention of Theorem~2 \sourcecite{ref:qlsboth-low-su}{LS26}.
progress: Theorem~2 achieves $Q_b=O(p^{-1/2})$ and $Q_A=O(KL\log(L/\epsilon))$, where $L=\max\{1,\log(p^{-1/2})\}$. Theorem~4 achieves $Q_A=O(K\log(1/\epsilon))$ with $Q_b=O(K\log(1/\epsilon))$ \sourcecite{ref:qlsboth-low-su}{LS26}.
Theorem~3 proves a worst-case $\Omega(p^{-1/2})$ state-preparation lower bound when the inverse-norm bound is tight \sourcecite{ref:qlsboth-low-su}{LS26}.

references.label: ref:qlsboth-low-su

comment: The gap is simultaneous attainment, not either bound separately. $K$ bounds the spectral condition number. Estimating an initially unknown $p$ is a separate resource question.
